claimText: If the aircraft fails to indicate that it is able to receive and acknowledge transmissions, separation shall be maintained based on the assumption that the aircraft will, in airspace where procedural separation is being applied, maintain the last assigned speed and level, or minimum flight altitude if higher, for a period of 20 minutes following the aircraft’s failure to report its position over a compulsory reporting point and thereafter adjust level and speed in accordance with the filed flight plan.
rationale: Enumerated list item 'b)1' defines the specific assumption for separation maintenance in procedural separation airspace.
